post_event.title: Post an ADP event
post_event.description: ADP's universal write. Every change -- hiring, terminating, changing a name, an address, a deduction -- is an event posted to `/events/{domain}/{version}/{event-name}`, and this tool reaches any of them, including events this pack has no typed tool for. Call `get_event_metadata` for the same event first: it returns the payload shape and the code values this client accepts.
